description: Verify that DHCPDISCOVER carries IPv4 destination = 255.255.255.255 (limited broadcast) (RFC 2131 §3.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
In INIT, the client doesn't know any specific server. RFC 2131 §3.1 requires DISCOVER to be sent to limited broadcast 255.255.255.255 so every DHCP server on the segment hears it.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER
   • IPv4 dst_ip == 255.255.255.255   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DISCOVER's IPv4 dst_ip is the all-ones limited broadcast.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_dst_ip_not_broadcast — DISCOVER dst_ip is not 255.255.255.255
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
